name: NYC Open Data API
tagline: Socrata-powered API for New York City public datasets and city records.
description: NYC Open Data exposes thousands of City of New York datasets through a SODA (Socrata Open Data API) interface on data.cityofnewyork.us. Developers can query JSON, CSV, and other formats for 311 complaints, taxi trips, inspections, permits, and more. Authentication is optional for light public use and recommended via app token for higher throughput.

auth.details: Optional. Public SODA reads work without credentials. A free Socrata app token (X-App-Token header or $$app_token query param) is not authentication; it identifies the app for a higher request pool vs low anonymous IP throttling. OAuth/user auth is separate and only needed for private/write access.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; higher throughput with free app token (exact quotas not published as a paid product).

rate_limits: Without app token: much lower IP-based throttling (exact threshold unpublished). With app token: substantially higher application-scoped limits; requests are generally unthrottled except under abuse/malicious traffic. Historical ~1,000 req/hour figures are not current official docs.
use_cases: query recent 311 service requests by borough or complaint type
fetch restaurant inspection grades and scores
pull taxi or for-hire vehicle trip sample records
list building permits or housing violations for an address
export open dataset rows as JSON or CSV for analysis
